The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass, 0 fail.

**Cause:** The applied migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`, so inserts failed with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`. The JS-facing `fullName` field is unchanged. The diff is 2 lines.

I didn't touch `migrations/`. I didn't commit anything.
